name: docdrift
description: Checks code against its design spec. A fast model (TypeSafe's Jev) screens every requirement in seconds; the agent investigates only what it flags. Java/Spring, JS/TS, Python, and any language by line range.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Used only by the docdrift MCP server to call api.typesafe.ai. Claude Code keeps it out of settings files (in the macOS Keychain, or ~/.claude/.credentials.json on other systems) and never shows it to the model. Get one at https://console.typesafe.ai
